close_reason: added names_match with RFC 4518 ASCII normalization via NormalizedIter; full Unicode deferred to v0.2
description:
Implement names_match(a: &Name, b: &Name) -> bool in pkix-path using proper RFC 4518 distinguished name comparison. This is a foundational helper used by both the chain linkage check (cert[i].issuer == cert[i+1].subject) and trust anchor matching.

Why not byte equality: RFC 5280 §7.1 explicitly requires case-insensitive matching and whitespace normalization for PrintableString/UTF8String/etc. Byte equality would reject chains where issuer and subject differ only in case or extra spaces — common in real CA software.

RFC 4518 string prep rules that must be implemented:
- Map: case fold, normalize whitespace (leading/trailing stripped, internal runs collapsed to single space)
- Normalize: Unicode NFKD normalization
- Prohibit: no prohibited characters check needed for DN comparison
- Match attribute-by-attribute: same number of RDNs, same OIDs, normalized values equal
- Multi-valued RDNs: set equality (order-independent within an RDN)

Implementation notes:
- x509-cert represents Name as a sequence of RelativeDistinguishedName, each a SET of AttributeTypeAndValue
- AttributeTypeAndValue.value is an Any; need to decode as DirectoryString (PrintableString | UTF8String | BMPString | TeletexString | UniversalString | IA5String)
- For no_std: use core::str for string ops; no Unicode normalization library available without alloc. Acceptable approximation for v0.1: implement case-fold and whitespace normalization; document that full NFKD is deferred.
- Must handle at minimum: UTF8String, PrintableString, IA5String (sufficient for PKITS)

Test vectors: construct Name pairs using OpenSSL or x509-cert builder; include cases that differ only in case, whitespace, encoding type.
title: pkix-path: Name comparison per RFC 4518 DN string prep
